unitTitle: Present Perfect - Past Simple - Ever/Never - Just - Yet/Already - For/Since
scanNote: 7-mashq ro'yxatida 7 ta so'z berilgan (yet, how long, never, since, just, for, ever), lekin 9 ta bo'shliq bor. 'never' va 'just' IKKI martadan ishlatiladi, 'for' esa umuman ishlatilmaydi — kitob ro'yxatga ortiqcha so'z qo'shgan.

sections.title: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple
sections.titleUz: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  ALREADY      9  NEVER
   2  FOR         10  EVER
   3  JUST        11  FOR
   4  NEVER       12  YET
   5  EVER        13  SINCE
   6  YET         14  JUST
   7  SINCE       15  NEVER
   8  ALREADY


UCh OLTIN QOIDA — HAMMASINI HAL QILADI:

  A) GAP TASDIQMI, INKORMI, SAVOLMI?
     TASDIQ  →  already, just, never
     INKOR   →  yet
     SAVOL   →  yet, ever

  B) 'FOR' MI, 'SINCE' MI?
     raqam + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     yil, oy, kun, 'last'  →  SINCE

  C) 'EVER' MI, 'NEVER' MI?
     SAVOLDA yoki USTUN DARAJA bilan → EVER
     TASDIQ gapda (inkor ma'no)      → NEVER


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'YES, we have ... visited the Statue of
     Liberty.'
    KALIT: 'YES' — gap IJOBIY.
    'never' inkor ma'no berardi.
    → ALREADY

 2  'a teacher ... thirty years'
    'thirty years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    → FOR

 3  'Yes, I have ... called her.'
    'ever' tasdiq gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

 4  'NO, I have ... been to Egypt.'
    KALIT: 'NO' — gap SALBIY.
    'have never been' = bormaganman.
    → NEVER

 5  'HAVE YOU ... been to a football match?'
    KALIT: bu SAVOL.
    Savolda 'ever' ishlatiladi.
    → EVER

 6  'I HAVEN'T finished my homework ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    'already' inkorda ishlatilmaydi.
    → YET

 7  'in Rio ... 1984'
    '1984' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

 8  'They have ... bought a computer.'
    TASDIQ gap.
    'yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.
    → ALREADY

 9  'Tracy has ... seen snow.'
    TASDIQ shakldagi gap, lekin ma'no
    INKOR (qorni ko'rmagan).
    'ever' tasdiq oddiy gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    → NEVER

10  'Cairo is the BEST place I've ... visited.'
    KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA.
    Bu qurilmada DOIM 'ever'.
    → EVER

11  'at university ... three years'
    'three years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    ('already' bu yerda mos kelmaydi —
     u vaqt miqdorini bildirmaydi.)
    → FOR

12  'The boat ... HASN'T LEFT ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    → YET

13  'Gary hasn't been abroad ... last summer.'
    'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

14  'Yes, I have ... packed it.'
    'since' bu yerda ma'nosiz.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

15  'I have ... travelled by train.'
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no.
    → NEVER


⚠ 9 va 15-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK:
  Gap TASDIQ shaklda ('has seen', 'have
  travelled'), lekin ma'no INKOR.

  'Tracy has NEVER seen snow.'
     = Treysi qorni hech qachon ko'rmagan

  'ever' bu yerda XATO, chunki 'ever' faqat
  savolda yoki ustun daraja bilan keladi.


⚠ 10-BAND — USTUN DARAJA QURILMASI:
  'the BEST place I've EVER visited'
  Bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladi —
  yagona holat.

  Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best
  place I've ever visited.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the Statue of Liberty = Ozodlik haykali
  a football match = futbol o'yini
  Rio  = Rio-de-Janeyro
  Malta = Malta
  abroad = chet elda
  a suitcase = chamadon
  by train = poyezdda

items.textEn: 1  Yes, we have never/already visited the Statue of Liberty.
items.uz: Ha, biz Ozodlik haykalini allaqachon ko'rganmiz.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YES' — gap IJOBIY.
'never' inkor ma'no berardi va 'Yes' ga zid
bo'lardi.
TASDIQ gapda → ALREADY.

items.textEn: 2  He has been a teacher for/since thirty years.
items.whyUz:
'thirty years' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI,
ya'ni DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

Savol: 'qancha vaqt?' → o'ttiz yil.

items.textEn: 3  A: Have you talked to Helen?  B: Yes, I have ever/just called her.
items.whyUz:
'EVER' oddiy TASDIQ gapda ISHLATILMAYDI
(faqat savolda yoki ustun daraja bilan).

'just' = hozirgina — kontekstga mos
('Have you talked to Helen?' savoliga
javob).

items.textEn: 4  No, I have ever/never been to Egypt.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'NO' — gap SALBIY.

'never' TASDIQ shaklda inkor ma'no beradi:
'I have NEVER been' = bo'lmaganman.

'ever' bu yerda XATO.

items.textEn: 5  Have you never/ever been to a football match?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: bu SAVOL ('Have you ...?').

Savolda DOIM 'ever' ishlatiladi.
'Have you never been?' — grammatik jihatdan
mumkin, lekin ajablanish ohangi (juda kam).

items.textEn: 6  I haven't finished my homework yet/already.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HAVEN'T' — INKOR gap.

'already' INKORDA ishlatilmaydi.
'yet' — savol va inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.

items.textEn: 7  She has lived in Rio for/since 1984.
items.whyUz:
'1984' — YIL, ya'ni ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

Savol: 'qachondan beri?' → 1984-yildan.

items.textEn: 8  They have already/yet bought a computer.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('They have bought').

'yet' TASDIQ gapda ishlatilmaydi.
'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

⚠ NOZIK BAND: gap TASDIQ shaklda
('has seen'), lekin ma'no INKOR.

'never' TASDIQ shaklda inkor ma'no beradi.
'ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 10  Cairo is the best place I've never/ever visited.
items.uz: Qohira — men borgan eng yaxshi joy.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA.

Bu qurilmada DOIM 'ever':
'the best place I've EVER visited'

Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best place
I've ever visited.'

Bu — 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladigan yagona
holat.

items.textEn: 11  I have been at university already/for three years.
items.whyUz:
'three years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

'already' vaqt MIQDORINI bildirmaydi,
shuning uchun 'three years' bilan mos
kelmaydi.

'at university' — artikl YO'Q (o'qish
ma'nosida).

items.textEn: 12  The boat to Malta hasn't left yet/already.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HASN'T' — INKOR gap.

'yet' — inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
leave → LEFT (V2 = V3).

items.textEn: 13  Gary hasn't been abroad for/since last summer.
items.uz: Gari o'tgan yozdan beri chet elga chiqmagan.
items.whyUz:
'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

DIQQAT — CHALG'ITUVCHI:
  'FOR a summer'      (davomiylik)
  'SINCE last summer' (nuqta)
'last' so'zi kalit.

items.textEn: 14  A: Have you packed your suitcase?  B: Yes, I have just/since packed it.
items.whyUz:
'since' — predlog, undan keyin vaqt kelishi
kerak ('since Monday'). Bu yerda ma'nosiz.

'just' = hozirgina — savolga mos javob.

Coursebook 107-bet, 14-mashq bilan bir xil
naqsh.

items.textEn: 15  I have never/ever travelled by train.
items.whyUz:
9-band bilan bir xil: TASDIQ shakl, INKOR
ma'no → NEVER.

'ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.

'BY train' — transport 'by' bilan, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect or past simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni present perfect yoki past simple ga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: HAVE YOU EVER BEEN to a circus?
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
    B: Yes, I WENT to one last year.
    A: DID YOU HAVE a good time?
    B: Oh yes! I HAD a lot of fun.

 2  A: DID YOU GO to the theatre last night?
    B: Yes, I SAW an excellent play.
    A: What DID YOU SEE?
    B: Romeo and Juliet.

 3  A: HAVE YOU DONE the shopping yet?
    B: Yes, I DID it this morning.
    A: HAVE YOU WASHED the car yet?
    B: Yes, I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.

 4  A: HAVE YOU EVER EATEN Chinese food?
    B: Yes, I ATE Chinese food last month.
    A: DID YOU LIKE it?
    B: No, it TASTED terrible.

 5  A: HAVE YOU EVER WORKED in a bar?
    B: Yes, I WORKED in a bar last summer.
    A: DID YOU ENJOY it?
    B: Yes, I ENJOYED it very much!


⚠ BUTUN MAShQNING NAQShI — BIR XIL:

  1-savol:  PRESENT PERFECT (tajriba)
            'Have you EVER ...?'
            yoki 'Have you ... YET?'
  1-javob:  PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt qo'shiladi)
            'Yes, I ... LAST YEAR / THIS
             MORNING / LAST MONTH.'
  2-savol:  PAST SIMPLE (o'sha voqea haqida)
            'DID you ...?'
  2-javob:  PAST SIMPLE

  Ya'ni: birinchi savol UMUMIY (Present
  Perfect), keyin suhbat O'SHA VOQEAGA
  o'tadi va PAST SIMPLE bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Have you ever BEEN to a circus?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
       'go' → BEEN (borib qaytgan)
    'I WENT to one LAST YEAR.'
       'last year' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU HAVE a good time?'
       o'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE
    'I HAD a lot of fun.'
       PAST SIMPLE

 2  'DID YOU GO to the theatre LAST NIGHT?'
       'last night' → PAST SIMPLE
    'I SAW an excellent play.'
       PAST SIMPLE (see → SAW)
    'What DID YOU SEE?'
       PAST SIMPLE savoli
       DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!

 3  'HAVE YOU DONE the shopping YET?'
       'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I DID it THIS MORNING.'
       'this morning' → PAST SIMPLE
       (ertalab tugagan)
    'HAVE YOU WASHED the car YET?'
       'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.'
       'already' → PRESENT PERFECT

 4  'Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
       eat → EATEN
    'I ATE Chinese food LAST MONTH.'
       'last month' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU LIKE it?'
       PAST SIMPLE
    'It TASTED terrible.'
       PAST SIMPLE

 5  'Have you ever WORKED in a bar?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I WORKED in a bar LAST SUMMER.'
       'last summer' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU ENJOY it?'
       PAST SIMPLE
    'I ENJOYED it very much!'
       PAST SIMPLE


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO — 'DID' DAN KEYIN:
  'DID you HAVE a good time?'  ✓
  'DID you HAD a good time?'   ✗
  'What DID you SEE?'          ✓
  'What DID you SAW?'          ✗

  'did' o'zi o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi,
  shuning uchun fe'l ASOSIY shaklda qoladi.


DIQQAT — 'TASTE + SIFAT':
  'It TASTED TERRIBLE.'  ✓
  'It tasted terriblY.'  ✗

  His fe'llaridan keyin SIFAT keladi
  (look, smell, taste, sound, feel).


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):
  go    → went   → BEEN/GONE
  have  → had    → HAD
  see   → saw    → SEEN
  do    → did    → DONE
  wash  → washed → WASHED
  eat   → ate    → EATEN
  like  → liked  → LIKED
  taste → tasted → TASTED
  work  → worked → WORKED
  enjoy → enjoyed → ENJOYED


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a circus      = sirk
  to have a good time = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq
  fun           = zavq, qiziq
  a play        = spektakl
  excellent     = a'lo
  a bar         = bar
  to enjoy      = zavqlanmoq

items.uz: Ha, o'tgan yili bittasiga borgan edim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'LAST YEAR' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT.

Savol Present Perfect da edi ('Have you ever
been'), lekin javobda aniq vaqt qo'shilgani
uchun Past Simple.

Suhbat endi O'SHA SAFAR haqida ('last year')
→ PAST SIMPLE savoli.

⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did you HAVE?'  ✓
  'Did you HAD?'   ✗

items.sentence: 1d  B: Oh yes! I ......................... (have) a lot of fun.

commonMistake.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE (o'sha safar haqida).
have → HAD.

'to have fun' = zavqlanmoq (turg'un ibora).

items.sentence: 2a  A: ................................... (you/go) to the theatre last night?

commonMistake.whyUz:
'LAST NIGHT' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.

DIQQAT: bu dialogda BIRINCHI savol ham Past
Simple da — chunki aniq vaqt aytilgan.
(1, 3, 4, 5-dialoglarda birinchi savol Present
Perfect edi.)

items.sentence: 2b  B: Yes, I ......................... (see) an excellent play.

commonMistake.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan kecha).
see → SAW.

'a play' = spektakl.
'excellent' = a'lo.

PAST SIMPLE savoli: DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl.

⚠ 'What did you SEE?'  ✓
   'What did you SAW?'  ✗

'did' o'zi o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi.

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
do → DONE (V3).

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

'THIS MORNING' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
do → DID.

DIQQAT: 'this morning' allaqachon TUGAGAN
(hozir kunduz yoki kechqurun), shuning uchun
Past Simple.

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
wash → WASHED (to'g'ri fe'l).

Grammar 64-betdagi misol bilan bir xil:
'Has he washed the car?'

KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
'I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.' ✓

KALIT: 'EVER' → PRESENT PERFECT.
eat → ate → EATEN (V3).

'ever' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

items.sentence: 4b  B: Yes, I ............................. (eat) Chinese food last month.
items.uz: Ha, o'tgan oyda xitoy taomini yedim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'LAST MONTH' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
eat → ATE (V2).

DIQQAT: savolda 'EATEN' (V3),
javobda 'ATE' (V2) — adashtirmang!

O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
'DID you LIKE?' ('liked' EMAS).

'like' — his fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.

PAST SIMPLE. taste → TASTED (to'g'ri fe'l).

⚠ 'taste + SIFAT':
  'It tasted TERRIBLE.'  ✓
  'It tasted terriblY.'  ✗

His fe'llaridan keyin SIFAT (look, smell,
taste, sound, feel).

KALIT: 'EVER' → PRESENT PERFECT.
work → WORKED (to'g'ri fe'l).

'work IN a bar' — predlog 'in'.

'LAST SUMMER' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.

DIQQAT: to'g'ri fe'lda V2 = V3 ('worked'),
shuning uchun shakli bir xil ko'rinadi —
lekin ZAMONI boshqa!

O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
'DID you ENJOY?' ('enjoyed' EMAS).

'to enjoy' — o'timli fe'l, to'ldiruvchi SHART
('enjoy IT').

PAST SIMPLE. enjoy → ENJOYED.

'very much' — gap oxirida.
'I enjoyed it very much' ✓
'I very much enjoyed it' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA, HAR BIRIDA (Yes) yoki (No).

KITOBDA IKKI NAMUNA BERILGAN (1 va 2).


IKKI QOLIP:

  (Yes) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: Yes, ... has/have ALREADY [V3] ...

  (No) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: No, ... hasn't/haven't [V3] ... YET.


BARCHA SAKKIZ DIALOG:

 1  (they/visit/San Diego) - (Yes)
    A: Have they visited San Diego YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY visited San
       Diego.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  (she/have/breakfast) - (No)
    A: Has she had breakfast YET?
    B: No, she hasn't had breakfast YET.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  (Bill/do/the shopping) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the shopping YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the shopping YET.

 4  (Laura/finish/her homework) - (Yes)
    A: Has Laura finished her homework YET?
    B: Yes, she has ALREADY finished her
       homework.

 5  (they/buy/their tickets) - (Yes)
    A: Have they bought their tickets YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY bought their
       tickets.

 6  (Bill/do/the ironing) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the ironing YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the ironing YET.

 7  (Mike/visit/the Louvre) - (Yes)
    A: Has Mike visited the Louvre YET?
    B: Yes, he has ALREADY visited the Louvre.

 8  (you/tidy/your room) - (No)
    A: Have you tidied your room YET?
    B: No, I haven't tidied my room YET.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) HAS yoki HAVE?
    Bill, Laura, Mike, she  →  HAS
    they, you               →  HAVE

 2) JAVOBDA EGA OLMOSHGA AYLANADI:
    'Bill' → 'HE'
    'Laura' → 'SHE'
    'Mike' → 'HE'
    'they' → 'THEY'

 3) 8-BANDDA EGALIK OLMOShI O'ZGARADI:
    Savol:  'Have YOU tidied YOUR room?'
    Javob:  'No, I haven't tidied MY room.'

    'your' → 'MY' (chunki javob beruvchi
    o'zi haqida gapiryapti).

    Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  have   →  HAD       (V2 = V3)
  do     →  DONE
  finish →  FINISHED  (to'g'ri)
  buy    →  BOUGHT    (V2 = V3)
  tidy   →  TIDIED    (y → i + ed)


DIQQAT — 'TIDIED':
  tidy → TIDIED (undoshdan keyingi 'Y' →
  I + ED).
  Grammar 64-bet: 'bury → buried' bilan bir
  xil qoida.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE BREAKFAST':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  Present Perfect da: 'has HAD breakfast'

  Ikki marta 'have' — biri yordamchi, biri
  asosiy fe'l:
     'she HAS HAD breakfast'
      ↑yordamchi ↑asosiy (V3)


UY IShLARI (3, 6-bandlar):
  do the shopping = xarid qilmoq
  do the ironing  = dazmollamoq


RASM:
  Ko'rfazdagi qayiqlar va orqada osmono'par
  binolar — SAN DIEGO (1-band).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  San Diego = San-Diyego (AQSh, Kaliforniya)
  breakfast = nonushta
  a ticket  = chipta
  the ironing = dazmollash
  the Louvre = Luvr muzeyi
  to tidy   = yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga solmoq

points.en: 1  A: Have they visited San Diego yet?  B: Yes, they have already visited San Diego.
points.uz: A: Ular San-Diyegoga borishdimi? B: Ha, allaqachon borishgan.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA (Yes).
Savolda YET (oxirida), javobda ALREADY
(have va V3 orasida).

points.en: 2  A: Has she had breakfast yet?  B: No, she hasn't had breakfast yet.
points.uz: A: U nonushta qildimi? B: Yo'q, hali nonushta qilmadi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA (No).
Savolda ham, javobda ham YET.

'has HAD' — biri yordamchi, biri asosiy fe'l.

points.en: 3  A: Has Bill done the shopping yet?  B: No, he hasn't done the shopping yet.
points.uz: A: Bill xaridni qildimi? B: Yo'q, hali qilmadi.

points.en: 4  A: Has Laura finished her homework yet?  B: Yes, she has already finished her homework.
points.uz: A: Laura uy vazifasini tugatdimi? B: Ha, allaqachon tugatdi.

points.en: 5  A: Have they bought their tickets yet?  B: Yes, they have already bought their tickets.
points.uz: A: Ular chiptalarini oldimi? B: Ha, allaqachon olishgan.
points.noteUz:
(Yes) → have ALREADY ...
'they' → HAVE.
buy → BOUGHT (V2 = V3).

points.en: 6  A: Has Bill done the ironing yet?  B: No, he hasn't done the ironing yet.
points.uz: A: Bill dazmolladimi? B: Yo'q, hali dazmollamadi.
points.noteUz:
(No) → hasn't ... YET.
'do the ironing' = dazmollamoq
(Grammar 65-betdagi misol).

points.en: 7  A: Has Mike visited the Louvre yet?  B: Yes, he has already visited the Louvre.
points.uz: A: Mayk Luvrga bordimi? B: Ha, allaqachon borgan.
points.noteUz:
(Yes) → has ALREADY ...
'the Louvre' — Coursebook 107-betdagi
Parij ro'yxatida ham bor edi.

points.en: 8  A: Have you tidied your room yet?  B: No, I haven't tidied my room yet.
points.uz: A: Xonangizni yig'ishtirdingizmi? B: Yo'q, hali yig'ishtirmadim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND — EGALIK OLMOSHI
O'ZGARADI:
  Savol: 'YOUR room'
  Javob: 'MY room'

tidy → TIDIED (y → i + ed).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in since or for, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: since yoki for ni qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  FOR   nine years    (NAMUNA)
   2  SINCE Monday
   3  SINCE 1971
   4  FOR   a day
   5  SINCE last month
   6  FOR   six weeks
   7  FOR   a weekend
   8  SINCE December
   9  FOR   five days
  10  SINCE yesterday
  11  SINCE last night
  12  FOR   a week

  Ya'ni: FOR — 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 12 (6 ta)
         SINCE — 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 11 (6 ta)

  Oltitadan TENG!


OLTIN QOIDA:

  FOR   +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
     nine years, a day, six weeks,
     a weekend, five days, a week

  SINCE +  QAChONDAN BERI (nuqta)
     Monday, 1971, last month, December,
     yesterday, last night


QANDAY AJRATISh — IKKI BELGI:

  A) 'A' yoki RAQAM bilan boshlansa → FOR
        FOR nine years
        FOR A day
        FOR six weeks
        FOR A weekend
        FOR five days
        FOR A week

  B) KUN, OY, YIL nomi yoki 'LAST',
     'YESTERDAY' → SINCE
        SINCE Monday      (kun nomi)
        SINCE 1971        (yil)
        SINCE December    (oy nomi)
        SINCE LAST month
        SINCE YESTERDAY
        SINCE LAST night


⚠ ENG NOZIK JUFTLIKLAR:

   4  FOR a day       ↔  10  SINCE yesterday
      (bir kun davomida)  (kechadan beri)

   7  FOR a weekend   ↔   2  SINCE Monday
      (bir dam olish       (dushanbadan beri)
       kuni davomida)

  12  FOR a week      ↔   5  SINCE last month
      (bir hafta          (o'tgan oydan beri)
       davomida)

  Farqi: 'A' bilan boshlansa MIQDOR;
  aniq nom bo'lsa NUQTA.


DIQQAT — 11-BAND, 'LAST NIGHT':
  'SINCE last night' = o'tgan kechadan beri

  DIQQAT: 'last night' — Past Simple
  ko'rsatkichi ham bo'lishi mumkin
  ('I went there LAST NIGHT'), lekin
  'since' bilan kelsa — Present Perfect.

  Farqi:
     'I saw him LAST NIGHT.'      (Past Simple)
     'I haven't seen him SINCE LAST NIGHT.'
                                  (Pres. Perf.)


DIQQAT — 10-BAND, 'YESTERDAY':
  'SINCE yesterday' = kechadan beri ✓
  'FOR yesterday' — XATO (ma'nosiz)

  Lekin 'yesterday' o'zi (since siz) —
  Past Simple ko'rsatkichi:
     'I saw him YESTERDAY.'


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  FOR:
     for two hours, for ten minutes,
     for a month, for ages, for a long time,
     for ever

  SINCE:
     since 2010, since April, since Christmas,
     since I was a child, since he left,
     since this morning


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + GAP:
  'since' dan keyin TO'LIQ GAP ham keladi:
     'since I was a child'
     'since he left'
  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a weekend = dam olish kunlari
  December  = dekabr
  a week    = hafta

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'nine years' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI
→ DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

'Monday' — HAFTA KUNI nomi, ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.
'1971' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

'a day' — 'A' bilan boshlanadi, ya'ni MIQDOR
→ FOR.

⚠ 10-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  FOR a day       (bir kun davomida)
  SINCE yesterday (kechadan beri)

'last month' — 'LAST' so'zi ANIQ NUQTANI
bildiradi → SINCE.

Solishtiring: 'FOR a month' (bir oy davomida).
'six weeks' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI → FOR.

'a weekend' — 'A' bilan, MIQDOR → FOR.

'a weekend' = shanba-yakshanba.

'December' — OY nomi, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

Oy nomlari BOSH HARF bilan yoziladi.
'five days' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI → FOR.

'yesterday' — ANIQ NUQTA (kecha) → SINCE.

'FOR yesterday' — ma'nosiz.

DIQQAT: 'yesterday' o'zi (since siz) —
Past Simple ko'rsatkichi:
'I saw him YESTERDAY.'

'last night' — 'LAST' bilan, ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.

DIQQAT — IKKI XIL ISHLATILISH:
  'I saw him LAST NIGHT.' (Past Simple)
  'I haven't seen him SINCE LAST NIGHT.'
     (Present Perfect)

'a week' — 'A' bilan, MIQDOR → FOR.

Solishtiring: 'SINCE last week'
(o'tgan haftadan beri).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in yet, how long, never, since, just, for or ever, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: yet, how long, never, since, just, for yoki ever ni qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  HOW LONG have you lived in Turkey?
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  Sophie has NEVER been to the opera before.
 3  I've JUST finished my homework.
 4  He has been working in Hungary SINCE 1993.
 5  No, I haven't paid it YET.
 6  HOW LONG have you worked here?
 7  Yes, I have JUST cleaned it.
 8  I have NEVER been fishing before.
 9  Have you EVER been on a canoe trip?


⚠ DIQQAT — RO'YXAT BILAN BO'ShLIQ SONI
MOS KELMAYDI:

  Ro'yxatda 7 so'z: yet, how long, never,
  since, just, for, ever
  Bo'shliqlar: 9 ta

  Demak ba'zi so'zlar IKKI marta ishlatiladi:
     HOW LONG — 1 va 6-bandlar
     NEVER    — 2 va 8-bandlar
     JUST     — 3 va 7-bandlar

  Va 'FOR' UMUMAN ishlatilmaydi —
  kitob ro'yxatga ortiqcha so'z qo'shgan.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  '... have you lived in Turkey?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  'Sophie has ... been to the opera BEFORE.'
    KALIT: 'BEFORE' (ilgari) — tajriba haqida.
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no → NEVER.

 3  'I've ... finished my homework.'
    TASDIQ gap, harakat yaqinda tugagan
    → JUST.
    ('yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi;
     'ever' oddiy tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.)

 4  'He has been working in Hungary ... 1993.'
    '1993' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

 5  'No, I HAVEN'T paid it ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap → YET (gap oxirida).

 6  '... have you worked here?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
    (1-band bilan bir xil.)

 7  'Yes, I HAVE ... cleaned it.'
    TASDIQ gap, 'Have you cleaned your room?'
    savoliga javob → JUST (hozirgina).
    (Ro'yxatda 'already' YO'Q, shuning uchun
     'just'.)

 8  'I have ... been fishing BEFORE.'
    KALIT: 'BEFORE' — tajriba haqida.
    → NEVER (2-band bilan bir xil).

 9  'HAVE YOU ... been on a canoe trip?'
    KALIT: bu SAVOL → EVER.


⚠ 'BEFORE' SO'ZI — MUHIM KALIT:
  2 va 8-bandlarda 'before' bor.

  'have never ... BEFORE' = ilgari hech
  qachon ...magan

  'before' tajriba haqidagi gaplarda
  'never' yoki 'ever' bilan keladi:
     'Have you been there BEFORE?'
     'I've NEVER been there BEFORE.'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'HAS BEEN WORKING':
  'He HAS BEEN WORKING in Hungary since 1993.'

  Bu — PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS
  (have been + V-ing).

  Enterprise 1 da bu zamon o'rganilmaydi,
  lekin kitob misolda ishlatgan.

  Ma'nosi: 1993-yildan beri ishlaydi va
  HOZIR HAM ishlaydi.

  Present Perfect bilan ham aytish mumkin:
     'He HAS WORKED in Hungary since 1993.'


DIQQAT — 'GO FISHING':
  'to go fishing' = baliq ovlagani bormoq
  Present Perfect da: 'have BEEN fishing'

  Shu kabi:
     go swimming → have been swimming
     go shopping → have been shopping
     go skiing   → have been skiing

  DIQQAT: 'GONE' emas, 'BEEN' —
  chunki qaytib kelgan (Grammar 65-bet
  qoidasi).


DIQQAT — 'A CANOE TRIP':
  'a canoe' = kanoe (yengil qayiq)
  O'qilishi: /kəˈnuː/ — 'kanu:'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How long ...?  = qancha vaqtdan beri?
  before         = ilgari
  Hungary        = Vengriya
  a phone bill   = telefon hisobi
  to pay         = to'lamoq (pay → PAID)
  to go fishing  = baliq ovlagani bormoq
  a canoe        = kanoe
  a canoe trip   = kanoeda sayohat

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.

'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect bilan
(agar hozir ham davom etayotgan bo'lsa).

items.sentence: 2  Sophie has ............................. been to the opera before.
items.uz: Sofi ilgari operaga hech qachon bormagan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'BEFORE' (ilgari) — TAJRIBA haqida.

Gap TASDIQ shaklda ('has been'), lekin ma'no
INKOR → NEVER.

'ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.

TASDIQ gap, harakat yaqinda tugagan → JUST.

'yet' — tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.
'ever' — oddiy tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.

'just' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

items.sentence: 4  He has been working in Hungary ............ 1993.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'1993' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

DIQQAT: 'HAS BEEN WORKING' — bu Present
Perfect Continuous (Enterprise 1 da
o'rganilmaydi).
Ma'nosi: 1993-dan beri ishlaydi va HOZIR HAM
ishlaydi.

items.sentence: 5  A: Have you paid the phone bill?  B: No, I haven't paid it ........................ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HAVEN'T' — INKOR gap → YET.

'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.

pay → PAID (V2 = V3).
'a phone bill' = telefon hisobi.

items.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
1-band bilan bir xil.

Javobi: 'For seven years.' yoki
'Since 1992.' (Grammar 65-bet misoli).

items.sentence: 7  A: Have you cleaned your room?  B: Yes, I have ................................... cleaned it.

commonMistake.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap → JUST (hozirgina).

DIQQAT: 'ALREADY' ham mos kelardi, lekin u
RO'YXATDA YO'Q — shuning uchun 'just'.

'just' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

items.uz: Ilgari hech qachon baliq ovlagani bormaganman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'BEFORE' — TAJRIBA haqida.
2-band bilan bir xil → NEVER.

'to go fishing' = baliq ovlagani bormoq.
Present Perfect da 'have BEEN fishing'
('gone' EMAS — qaytib kelgan).

items.sentence: 9  Have you ........................ been on a canoe trip?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: bu SAVOL ('Have you ...?') → EVER.

Savolda DOIM 'ever'.

'a canoe' — o'qilishi /kəˈnuː/ ('kanu:').

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 66-bet — Present Perfect ravishlari va zamonlar farqi.

groups.explanationUz: Bu jadval 3-mashqning barcha 15 bandini hal qiladi.

patterns.formula: HAVE + [ega] + [V3] + ... YET?  —  Yes, ... have ALREADY [V3].  /  No, ... haven't [V3] ... YET.
patterns.exampleEn: Have they visited San Diego yet? — Yes, they have already visited San Diego. — No, she hasn't had breakfast yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular San-Diyegoga borishdimi? — Ha, allaqachon borishgan. — Yo'q, hali nonushta qilmadi.

patterns.formula: HAVE you EVER [V3] ... ?  —  Yes, I [V2] ... [ANIQ VAQT].  —  DID you [V1] ... ?
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever eaten Chinese food? — Yes, I ate Chinese food last month. — Did you like it?
patterns.exampleUz: Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rganmisiz? — Ha, o'tgan oyda yedim. — Yoqdimi?

patterns.exampleEn: How long have you lived in Turkey? — For nine years. / Since 1971.
patterns.exampleUz: Turkiyada qancha vaqtdan beri yashaysiz? — To'qqiz yildan beri. / 1971-yildan beri.
patterns.explanationUz: 'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: Sophie has never been to the opera before. I have never been fishing before.
patterns.exampleUz: Sofi ilgari operaga hech qachon bormagan. Ilgari baliq ovlagani bormaganman.

patterns.exampleEn: Cairo is the best place I've ever visited.
patterns.exampleUz: Qohira — men borgan eng yaxshi joy.
patterns.explanationUz:
'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladigan YAGONA holat —
ustun daraja qurilmasi.
